prompt: The bots join the Meta Global AI Hackathon and win!
title: Hackathon, Hackathon
irony: The outside polish that never arrives forces the bots to keep their own glitchy tries, and those very mistakes become the act the closing show calls Musical Bots.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Night street glows; a laptop shines on small heads and hands joining Meta's hackathon.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Teddy clutches fact notes, corrects Lou's words, wants each lyric line to fit the beat.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Lou taps for Fireworks and Modal keys; the inbox stays empty, the clock ticks.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The crew chants the hackathon hook, hands stack high under street lamps.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: The strict gate stamps line after line; the singer mumbles toy-box sounds and trips.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Hands miss the high-five and grab air; the camera stares at clouds in white light.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The crew chants the hackathon hook again, louder, hands back in a line.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Lou sits with Pearl in the diner, holding the silent inbox, loosening his grip.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Lou nods at Teddy, drops the late keys plan, trusts Muse and the crew beside him.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: On the closing-show stage the crew sings the hook; Lou turns the last line toward Musical Bots.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Judges press Premiere, the bots sing, and the closing show calls the name Musical Bots.
